archetypes.name: Enchantments and Roles
archetypes.focus: Build around enchantments and Role tokens to enhance creatures and trigger enchantment payoffs.

archetypes.name: Faeries
archetypes.focus: Use evasive Faeries and flash-speed interaction to pressure opponents while playing at instant speed.

archetypes.name: Rats
archetypes.focus: Go wide with Rats and use sacrifice or death synergies to turn expendable creatures into value.

archetypes.name: Celebration
archetypes.focus: Play multiple permanents in a turn to trigger Celebration and keep up an aggressive board.

archetypes.name: Enchanted Creatures
archetypes.focus: Combine efficient creatures with enchantments and Roles for a resilient board with strong payoffs.

archetypes.name: Bargain and Sacrifice
archetypes.focus: Bargain expendable tokens or permanents and gain value from sacrificing creatures.

archetypes.name: Spells
archetypes.focus: Cast instants and sorceries to trigger spells-matter payoffs and maintain tempo.

archetypes.name: Food and Bargain
archetypes.focus: Create Food and other expendable artifacts to support Bargain, life-gain, and sacrifice synergies.

archetypes.name: Aggro and Celebration
archetypes.focus: Curve out with creatures and use Celebration payoffs to reward developing your board each turn.

archetypes.name: Adventure Value
archetypes.focus: Use Adventure cards for flexible early plays and later creature value, backed by card selection.
